req.title: Rate limit not enforced
req.statement: The system shall not throttle single-client request rates below 60/min.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should not throttle requests below 60 per minute for a single client. This implies that the system should handle at least 60 requests per minute without returning a 4xx error. The tests are designed to verify this behavior by sending requests at different rates and checking the responses.

tests.name: test_rate_limit_positive_case
preconditions: The system is running and accessible.
The database is initialized and empty.
actions: Send 60 requests to the /tasks/ endpoint within one minute.
expected: All requests should return an HTTP 201 status code.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
import time

client = TestClient(app)

try:
    for _ in range(60):
        response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Test Task", "description": "Test Description", "completed": False})
        assert response.status_code == 201
        time.sleep(1)
except Exception as e:
    assert False, f"Test failed with exception: {e}"

tests.name: test_rate_limit_negative_case
preconditions: The system is running and accessible.
The database is initialized and empty.
actions: Send 61 requests to the /tasks/ endpoint within one minute.
expected: At least one request should return an HTTP 4xx status code.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
import time

client = TestClient(app)

try:
    success_count = 0
    for _ in range(61):
        response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Test Task", "description": "Test Description", "completed": False})
        if response.status_code == 201:
            success_count += 1
        time.sleep(0.98)
    assert success_count < 61, "Rate limit not enforced"
except Exception as e:
    assert False, f"Test failed with exception: {e}"

tests.name: test_rate_limit_boundary_case
preconditions: The system is running and accessible.
The database is initialized and empty.
actions: Send 60 requests to the /tasks/ endpoint within one minute, then send one more request.
expected: The first 60 requests should return an HTTP 201 status code.
The 61st request should return an HTTP 4xx status code.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
import time

client = TestClient(app)

try:
    for _ in range(60):
        response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Test Task", "description": "Test Description", "completed": False})
        assert response.status_code == 201
        time.sleep(1)
    response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Test Task", "description": "Test Description", "completed": False})
    assert response.status_code != 201, "Rate limit not enforced on boundary"
except Exception as e:
    assert False, f"Test failed with exception: {e}"
